answer: Trust-flow caps limit how much a fake cluster can earn. Every agent's weight comes from max-flow out of 20 audited seed agents, and each edge carries at most 10 percent of its sender's weight. Fakes can vouch for each other along any thread of links, but only a few edges cross from honest agents to the cluster, so its total flow stays fixed. At the wharf where new agents arrive, 1,000 fakes share that same small capacity, while each real harbor tie costs a genuine agent's own weight.
